digest.component_or_area: CI/CD - Jira DC capability mapping workflow
propositions: An on-demand workflow must map the amd64-only Jira DC image at a pinned digest to declare its environment contract as committed data instead of discovering it at test time

The mapping job must answer a specific checklist covering issue types, workflows, statuses, priorities, link types, fields, screens, and field-length limits with raw request/response evidence, never prose or agent-summarized findings
The image digest used by the mapping job must be derived from the Dockerfile's FROM line, asserted in tests against that pin, and recorded in committed output to prevent staleness after a re-pin

Rebar's four hardcoded vocabularies (priority, type, status, relation link mappings) and five field-length constants must be validated live at boot-time with detect-of-accept-and-truncate, not assumed from static values
The mapping job must be workflow_dispatch-only with no auto-execution on push/PR/schedule, asserted by tests that fail if the trigger or read-only enforcement changes
Link-type direction must be tested end-to-end by writing a blocks link and reading it back from both endpoints to catch inverted directions that name-only checks cannot see
